This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

tools.name: Agent
tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt

- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start

- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

104	### 4.2 MlpWeights（源码名 `MLP`）：gate+up 合存
105	
106	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
107	
108	Qwen3 的 MLP 是 SwiGLU：\( y = \text{down}\big(\text{SiLU}(\text{gate}(x)) \odot \text{up}(x)\big) \)。`gate_proj` 与 `up_proj` 都是 \( \text{intermediate} \times \text{hidden} \)，且**吃同一段输入** \( x \)——正好满足融合条件。于是两者按行堆叠成 \( 2 \times \text{intermediate} \times \text{hidden} \) 的 `gate_up_proj`；`down_proj`（\( \text{hidden} \times \text{intermediate} \)）输入是逐元素乘积，保持独立。
109	
110	这里"行偏移"同样只有两个值：gate 在 \( [0, \text{inter}) \)、up 在 \( [\text{inter}, 2\text{inter}) \)（TP 下用本地 `inter`）。
111	
112	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
113	
114	1. 装载期：`gate_proj.weight` + `up_proj.weight` → `fused_rows` → \( (2 \times \text{inter}_{\text{local}}) \times \text{hidden} \) 单矩阵。
115	2. 运行期：
116	   - gate_out = GEMM(gate_up_proj 行 \( [0, \text{inter}) \), normed)
117	   - up_out = GEMM(gate_up_proj 行 \( [\text{inter}, 2\text{inter}) \), normed)
118	   - act = SiLU(gate_out) ⊙ up_out
119	   - mlp_out = GEMM(down_proj, act)
120	
121	Qwen3-4B（inter=9728, hidden=2560，TP=1）：`gate_up_proj` 是 \( 19456 \times 2560 \)，gate 段 [0, 9728)，up 段 [9728, 19456)。

149	### 4.3 Qwen3Model：权重 + 配置，不含请求状态
150	
151	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
152	
153	`Qwen3Model` 是"这台推理发动机的静止部分"：词嵌入、每层权重、最终 norm、RoPE 表、配置、TP 通信子，以及（若启用）打包的 LoRA 注册表。它的文档注释只有一句话——"weights and config only. Request state is owned by the executor."这句话是整个 crate 所有权设计的分水岭：
154	
155	- **模型侧（本讲）**：装载后基本不可变（唯一例外是 LoRA 热装卸）。权重指针稳定，是 CUDA Graph 捕获/重放的前提（图会把指针"烤"进录制流，u3-l5）。
156	- **执行器侧（u3 单元）**：每个请求的 KV 页、位置、采样参数、草稿状态都由 executor/调度器持有，随请求生灭。
157	
158	这样切分的直接收益：模型可以在 TP 下"每 rank 一个、绝不跨线程共享"地被 move 进各自的 worker 线程；服务循环对模型只读，天然无数据竞争。
159	
160	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
161	
162	一个 `Qwen3Model` 的字段可以分四组来记：
163	
164	1. **设备与配置**：`ctx`（CUDA 设备上下文）、`config`（u2-l1 的 `Config`）、`tensor_parallel`、`decode_projection_path`（u3-l8 的融合路径选择结果，装载期定死）。
165	2. **权重本体**：`embed_tokens`（\( \text{vocab} \times \text{hidden} \)）、`lm_head: Option<DeviceMatrix>`（tied 时为 `None`）、`layers: Vec<TransformerBlock>`（36 层）、`norm`（最终 RMSNorm）。
166	3. **常量表**：`cos_cache` / `sin_cache`（RoPE 预计算表）、`logits_tail_suppress`（对齐填充的词表尾部抑制 ids）。
167	4. **服务机制开关与 LoRA**：`enable_cuda_graph`、`tp_comm`（NCCL 通信子）、`lora_adapters` / `packed_lora` / `max_loras` / `max_lora_rank`（u7 详讲）。
168	
169	其中 `TransformerBlock`（[src/weights.rs:L122-L128](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L122-L128)）= 两个 RMSNorm 向量 + 一个 `Attention` + 一个 `MLP`，正是一个解码层的全部静止状态。

172	
173	**结构体与文档注释**——[src/weights.rs:L331-L351](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L331-L351)：`Qwen3Model` 全字段如上分组；注意 `lm_head` 是 `Option`。
174	
175	**Send/Sync 的 SAFETY 说明**——[src/weights.rs:L353-L357](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L353-L357)：手动 `unsafe impl Send/Sync`，理由写在注释里——"每个模型实例钉在一个 CUDA 设备上，同一时刻只由一个 worker 线程驱动；TP 路径每 rank 一个模型，从不在多线程间共享同一个 rank 本地模型"。这是 4.3.1 所有权设计的 unsafe 背书。

201	### 4.4 Qwen3MemoryOptions：显存预算三参数
202	
203	#### 4.4.1 概念说明
204	
205	权重装载完只是显存账本的第一行。KV 池能开多大，由 `Qwen3MemoryOptions` 的三个参数决定。它模仿 vLLM 的 `gpu_memory_utilization` 语义：**KV 池拿走"预算内扣除权重、画像出的非 KV 运行时峰值、安全余量"之后的剩余部分**。三个参数各管一件事：
206	
207	| 参数 | 默认值 | 管什么 |
208	| --- | --- | --- |
209	| `gpu_memory_utilization` | 0.90 | 总预算 = \( \text{设备总显存} \times \) 该比例；要求 \( (0, 1] \) |
210	| `kv_cache_memory_margin_bytes` | 150 MiB | 在画像峰值之外再扣的固定安全垫，覆盖分配器碎片与未画像到的小额漂移 |
211	| `page_size` | 16 | KV 页粒度（每页容纳的 token 数）；合法值只有 {16, 64}，由 FlashInfer 分页注意力内核决定（见源码引用的 #545） |
212	
213	定性公式（完整画像流程在 u2-l4）：
214	
215	\[
216	\text{kv\_budget} = \underbrace{\text{total} \times u}_{\text{requested}} - \Big( \underbrace{\text{initial\_used}}_{\text{权重等}} + \underbrace{\text{non\_kv\_peak}}_{\text{画像峰值增量}} + \underbrace{m}_{\text{margin}} \Big)
217	\]
218	
219	每 KV 块的字节数则有唯一公式（`kv_bytes_per_block`，见下）：
220	
221	\[
222	\text{bytes\_per\_block} = \text{num\_layers} \times 2 \times \text{num\_kv\_heads} \times \text{head\_dim} \times \text{block\_size} \times 2\,\text{B}
223	\]
224	
225	（因子 2 = K 与 V 各一份；最后一个 2 = bf16。）`page_size` 越大，块越"粗"，前缀匹配的粒度越粗（u5-l1），但每块字节数成比例增大；它不改变总预算，只改变切分粒度与最小可分配单位。
226	
227	#### 4.4.2 核心流程
228	
229	1. `Qwen3MemoryOptions::new(u, margin, page)` 构造（const fn），`Default` 给 `(0.90, 150 MiB, 16)`。
230	2. 使用前必须 `validate()`：\( u \in (0, 1] \)，`page_size ∈ {16, 64}`，否则立即报错。
231	3. 启动画像（`profiled_kv_budget`，u2-l4 详讲）先 `validate()`，再以 `page_size` 构造 KV 几何、按上式算每块字节，最后从预算里数出块数（不足 64 块的最低限直接拒绝启动）。
232	4. `page_size` 同时决定调度器的 token 粒度：一个请求占用的 KV 页数 = \( \lceil \text{len} / \text{page\_size} \rceil \)。
233

257	   - 再算 page_size=64 时的每块字节（应为 9 MiB），并算 24 GB 卡、utilization=0.90、暂不计权重时最多能容纳多少个 16-token 块（量级估算即可）。
258	2. 需要观察的现象：lib 单测在无 GPU 环境也能编译并通过（它只做整数与字符串断言）；`--lib` 过滤器只命中一个测试。
259	3. 预期结果：每块 2.25 MiB（page 16）/ 9 MiB（page 64）；24 GB × 0.9 ≈ 21.6 GB 的量级里若全给 KV（现实中要先扣权重，此处仅为公式练习）约可容纳 ~9100 个 16-token 块。单测运行结果待本地验证（取决于本地工具链）。
260	
261	#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案
262	
263	**练习 1**：为什么 `page_size` 只允许 16 或 64？
264	
265	答案：KV 池的分页注意力内核来自 FlashInfer，其内核只接受这两个页尺寸（源码注释指向 #545）。选 64 时每块覆盖更多 token、页表更短，但小请求的尾部浪费更大；选 16 更细但页表项更多。这是内核能力约束，不是任意调参。
266	
267	**练习 2**：把 `gpu_memory_utilization` 设成 1.0 合法吗？设成 0.0 呢？
268	
269	答案：1.0 合法（区间是半开的 \( (0, 1] \)），但画像若发现非 KV 占用已经吃满预算会拒绝启动；0.0 非法，`validate()` 的第一条 ensure 直接拒绝——预算为零意味着连 64 块的最小池都不可能（[src/weights.rs:L66-L70](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L66-L70)）。
270	
271	**练习 3**：`kv_cache_memory_margin_bytes` 与 `gpu_memory_utilization` 都是"留余量"，区别是什么？
272	
273	答案：utilization 在**总量**层面封顶（比例），margin 在**分配**层面扣减（固定字节，盖碎片与未画像漂移）。前者决定池子最大多大，后者决定画像峰值之外还要再让出多少才敢把剩余全部划给 KV——两者叠加后才是 `kv_budget_bytes`。
274	
275	## 5. 综合实践
276	
277	**任务：手工推导 Qwen3-4B 的 QKV + MLP 权重字节数，并用 `sizing.rs` 的 checked 乘加写成单测。**
278	
279	这是本讲的收官实践，把 4.1/4.2 的形状、4.3 的所有权、4.4 的预算意识串成一条线：**知道权重占多少字节，才能看懂 u2-l4 里"预算扣掉权重之后剩多少给 KV"的账本。**
280	
281	### 5.1 手工推导（Qwen3-4B，TP=1，bf16）
282	
283	几何：`hidden=2560, layers=36, heads=32, kv_heads=8, head_dim=128, intermediate=9728`，故 \( q_{\text{dim}} = 32 \times 128 = 4096 \)，\( kv_{\text{dim}} = 8 \times 128 = 1024 \)。

285	| 矩阵 | 形状 | 元素数 | bf16 字节 | 每层 |

287	| `qkv_proj` | \( 6144 \times 2560 \) | 15,728,640 | 31,457,280 B | **30 MiB** |

291	- 每层 QKV+MLP 合计：\( 30 + 95 + 47.5 = 172.5 \) MiB。
292	- 36 层合计：\( 172.5 \times 36 = 6210 \) MiB ≈ 6.06 GiB（精确值 6,511,656,960 字节）。
293	- （延伸）`o_proj` \( 2560 \times 4096 \) 每层 20 MiB，36 层 720 MiB；`embed_tokens`（tied，兼作输出投影）\( 151936 \times 2560 \times 2 \approx 741.6 \) MiB。全模型约 4.02B 参数 ≈ 7.5 GiB——与"Qwen3-4B"的名字对上。

295	### 5.2 写成单测
296	
297	先看工具：[src/sizing.rs:L1-L22](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs#L1-L22) 只有两个函数——`product`（`checked_mul` 折叠，溢出报 "sizing overflow in product"）与 `sum`（`checked_add`）。模块注释说明了它存在的意义：**预算在配置维度通过张量校验之前就要计算，坏配置必须在这里响亮失败，而不是回绕成少预留**。这正是 u2-l4 显存画像所有乘法的地基。
298	
299	由于 `product`/`sum` 是 `pub(crate)`（同理 `Attention`/`MLP`/`Qwen3Model` 也只在 crate 内可见，u1-l1 已建立"runtime 再导出才是公共边界"的认知），这个练习测试**必须写进 crate 内部**——在**你自己的工作副本**里把它加到 [src/weights.rs:L959](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L959) 之后的 `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` 中（学习练习，勿提交）：

303	use crate::sizing::{product, sum};
304

306	const LAYERS: usize = 36;

315	    let gate_up = product(&[2 * INTER, HIDDEN, BF16])?;
316	    let down = product(&[HIDDEN, INTER, BF16])?;
317	    let per_layer = sum(&[qkv, gate_up, down])?;
318	    let all_layers = product(&[per_layer, LAYERS])?;

321	    assert_eq!(gate_up, 99_614_720);      // 95 MiB

329	### 5.3 对照与验证
330	
331	1. 与 `weights.rs` 已有测试对照组织方式：[src/weights.rs:L969-L1003](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L969-L1003) 的 KV 预算测试同样用字面常量构造几何（36 层/8 头/128 维/16 块）、用 `expect_err` + `contains("overflow")` 断言失败形态——你的字节数测试与它们同处一个模块、共享同一风格。

333	3. 运行：`cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --lib weights::tests::qwen3_4b`。该测试只做整数运算，无需 GPU；通过与否取决于你手工推导的数字——本文的推导已逐步列出，运行结果待本地验证。
334	
335	## 6. 本讲小结
336	
337	- `Attention` 把 Q/K/V 按行堆成单矩阵 \( (q_{\text{dim}} + 2kv_{\text{dim}}) \times \text{hidden} \)，前向用行偏移 \( 0 / q_{\text{dim}} / q_{\text{dim}}+kv_{\text{dim}} \) 读取（[src/batch_decode.rs:L346-L372](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/batch_decode.rs#L346-L372)），融合只是拼字节，零额外显存。
338	- `MLP` 同理把 gate+up 合成 \( 2\text{inter} \times \text{hidden} \)，偏移 0 与 inter；`o_proj`/`down_proj` 因输入不同源而保持独立。
339	- `Qwen3Model` = 权重 + 配置 + 常量表（RoPE/norm）+ 机制开关，**不含任何请求状态**；请求状态归 executor，这使稳态服务对模型只读，是 CUDA Graph 指针稳定与 TP 每 rank 一份的前提。
340	- `Qwen3MemoryOptions` 三参数分工：utilization 定总预算、margin 定画像外安全垫、page_size 定 KV 块粒度（只允许 16/64，FlashInfer 内核约束）。
341	- 每块 KV 字节数有唯一公式Owner `kv_bytes_per_block`，且一切尺寸乘法必须走 [src/sizing.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs) 的 checked 乘加——坏配置要响亮失败，不许回绕成少预留。
342	- Qwen3-4B 的 QKV+MLP 权重共约 6210 MiB（每层 172.5 MiB：30 + 95 + 47.5），全模型约 7.5 GiB——这是 u2-l4 显存账本里"权重"那一行的数值。
343	
344	## 7. 下一步学习建议
345	
346	本讲看到的是"静止的模型"。下一讲 **u2-l3（checkpoint 装载）** 讲这堆矩阵是怎么从 safetensors 分片走进显存的：`load_shard_info` 的分片探测、`StagedWeightLoader` 的"先记录整个计划再上传"两阶段结构、以及 TP>1 时 `shard_range`/`col_shard` 的行切与列切边界。之后 **u2-l4（显存画像与 KV 预算）** 会把本讲 4.4 的定性公式展开成 `profiled_kv_budget` 的完整账本：画像临时块、激活峰值测量、`servable_len` 折算。建议顺带重读 [src/weights.rs:L692-L818](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L692-L818)，此时你已能认出其中每一个字段。

# 权重布局：Qwen3Model 与内存选项

## 1. 本讲目标

上一讲（u2-l1）我们看清了 `config.json` 如何经过分层校验变成 `Config`。本讲沿着数据流往前走一步：这些配置维度最终变成**哪些显存对象、以什么形状躺在 GPU 上**。学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 解释 Qwen3 为什么把 Q/K/V 三个投影合成一个矩阵、把 gate/up 两个投影合成一个矩阵，以及前向时如何用**行偏移**在合存矩阵里"切"出各个投影（零额外显存）。
2. 说出 `Qwen3Model` 的所有权设计：它只装"权重 + 配置"，一切请求状态都归 executor——并解释这个划分为什么是 CUDA Graph 与张量并行的前提。
3. 理解 `Qwen3MemoryOptions` 三个参数（`gpu_memory_utilization` / `kv_cache_memory_margin_bytes` / `page_size`）分别如何影响 KV 池的总量、安全余量与块粒度。
4. 手工推导 Qwen3-4B 全部 QKV 与 MLP 权重的 bf16 字节数，并会使用 `src/sizing.rs` 的 checked 乘加函数把推导写成单测。

> 命名提示：大纲里把这组结构称为 AttentionWeights / MlpWeights，源码中的真实名字是 `Attention` 与 `MLP`（见 [src/weights.rs:L100-L120](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L100-L120)）。本讲一律使用源码名。

## 2. 前置知识

- **bf16（brain float 16）**：Qwen3 权重与激活的数值类型，每个元素 2 字节。本讲所有字节数都按 \( \text{元素数} \times 2 \) 计算。
- **row-major 矩阵与 GEMM 视角**：本 crate 的权重矩阵是"行 = 输出维、列 = 输入维"的 row-major 布局。一次线性层就是 \( y = W x \)，其中 \( W \in \mathbb{R}^{\text{out} \times \text{in}} \)。把两个线性层的权重**纵向堆叠**（行拼接）后，一次 GEMM 就能同时算出两者的输出——这是"合存"的全部动机。
- **GQA 几何**（u2-l1 已建立）：`q_dim = num_attention_heads × head_dim`，`kv_dim = num_key_value_heads × head_dim`，且 Qwen3-4B 的 `head_dim` 直接写在 config.json 里（128），并非 `hidden_size / num_heads`。
- **tie_word_embeddings**：Qwen3-4B 等小尺寸模型把输出投影（lm_head）与输入词嵌入 `embed_tokens` 共用同一份矩阵，不单独存权重。
- **页式 KV cache**：KV 缓存按"页/块"（page/block）为单位管理，每块容纳 `page_size` 个 token。本讲只关心 `page_size` 的合法值与每块字节数公式；完整的启动期显存画像留给 u2-l4。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 |
| --- | --- |
| [src/weights.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs) | 权重数据布局的"户口本"：`Attention`、`MLP`、`TransformerBlock`、`Qwen3Model`、`Qwen3MemoryOptions`、`KvBudget`，以及 KV 每块字节数的唯一定义点；文件尾部还有 `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` |
| [src/weights/load.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs) | 装载侧：把 checkpoint 里三个/两个独立张量经 `fused_rows` 融合成单矩阵（本讲引用，深讲在 u2-l3） |
| [src/sizing.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs) | 全部 23 行：`product` / `sum` 两个 checked 乘加函数，防预算溢出的第一道闸 |
| [src/batch_decode.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/batch_decode.rs) | 消费侧证据：解码前向如何用行偏移 `0 / q_dim / q_dim + kv_dim` 从 `qkv_proj` 里分别读出 Q、K、V |
| [src/batch_decode_dag.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/batch_decode_dag.rs) | 消费侧证据：`mlp_gate_proj` / `mlp_up_proj` 如何用行偏移读 `gate_up_proj` |
| [src/config.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs) | `Config` 字段与 `local_*` 系列辅助函数（TP 下的本地维度换算，[src/config.rs:L346-L364](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/config.rs#L346-L364)） |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 AttentionWeights（源码名 `Attention`）：QKV 合存矩阵

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

HuggingFace checkpoint 里，每层注意力有三个独立张量：`q_proj.weight`（\( q_{\text{total}} \times \text{hidden} \)）、`k_proj.weight` 与 `v_proj.weight`（各 \( kv_{\text{total}} \times \text{hidden} \)）。推理引擎在服务时每步都要对同一段输入 \( x \)（hidden 维）做三次投影。三次小 GEMM 有三次 kernel 启动开销，且 batch 小的时候 GEMM 形状"瘦长"、算力利用率低。

解法很朴素：装载时把三个矩阵**按行堆叠**成一个 \( (q_{\text{dim}} + 2 \times kv_{\text{dim}}) \times \text{hidden} \) 的大矩阵。之后有两种用法：

- **融合路径**：一次 GEMM 算出整个 \( q_{\text{dim}} + 2kv_{\text{dim}} \) 的输出，再拆成 Q/K/V（u3-l8 的投影融合）；
- **拆分路径**：对同一大矩阵分别以行区间 \( [0, q_{\text{dim}}) \)、\( [q_{\text{dim}}, q_{\text{dim}} + kv_{\text{dim}}) \)、\( [q_{\text{dim}} + kv_{\text{dim}},\ q_{\text{dim}} + 2kv_{\text{dim}}) \) 各做一次 GEMM——这就是"行偏移访问"，不需要拷贝出子矩阵，零额外显存。

注意 `Attention` 里还有 Qwen3 特有的 `q_norm` / `k_norm`（各 `head_dim` 维的 RMSNorm 权重，Qwen3 在 Q、K 上逐头做 norm）以及独立的 `o_proj`。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

以 TP=1、Qwen3-4B（hidden=2560, heads=32, kv_heads=8, head_dim=128）为例：

1. 装载期（u2-l3 详讲）：三个 safetensors 张量 → `fused_rows` → 一个 \( 6144 \times 2560 \) 的 `DeviceMatrix`（\( 6144 = 4096 + 2 \times 1024 \)）。
2. 运行期拆分路径（数值基线，#75 保留）：
   - Q = GEMM(qkv_proj 的行 \( [0, 4096) \), x)
   - K = GEMM(行 \( [4096, 5120) \), x)
   - V = GEMM(行 \( [5120, 6144) \), x)
3. 运行期融合路径：一次 GEMM 得 \( 6144 \) 维输出，再 `split_qkv` 拆三段。
4. QK norm + RoPE → KV 写入页池 → 注意力 → `o_proj`（独立矩阵，\( \text{hidden} \times q_{\text{dim}} \)）回投影。

行偏移的通用公式：

\[
\text{offset}(Q) = 0,\qquad \text{offset}(K) = q_{\text{dim}},\qquad \text{offset}(V) = q_{\text{dim}} + kv_{\text{dim}}
\]

TP>1 时各部分先在源矩阵的行维上按 `shard_range` 切片再融合，所以每 rank 的 `q_dim`/`kv_dim` 是本地值（见 4.1.3 第一条链接）。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**结构体定义**——注释即契约："QKV stored as a single concatenated matrix [q_dim + 2*kv_dim, hidden_size]. Individual projections accessed via row offsets (zero extra memory)"。[src/weights.rs:L100-L111](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L100-L111) 定义了 `Attention`：`qkv_proj`（融合矩阵）、`o_proj`、`q_norm`/`k_norm`（head_dim 维），以及记录本地几何的 `q_dim`/`kv_dim` 两个字段——**偏移量不是算出来的，是随权重一起带着的**。

**装载时怎么融合**——[src/weights/load.rs:L152-L157](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L152-L157) 先从 `Config` 算出全量行数 `q_total = num_attention_heads × head_dim`、`kv_total = num_key_value_heads × head_dim`，再交给 `tensor_parallel.shard_range` 得到每 rank 的 `(row_offset, rows)`；随后 [src/weights/load.rs:L163-L188](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights/load.rs#L163-L188) 用三个 `FusedPart`（q/k/v 各一个，带各自的 `src_rows/row_offset/rows`）调用 `loader.fused_rows` 生成单矩阵。注释点明：`shard_range` 对 world_size == 1 也成立（offset 0、全行），所以一条代码路径同时服务单卡与 TP。

### 4.2 MlpWeights（源码名 `MLP`）：gate+up 合存

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

Qwen3 的 MLP 是 SwiGLU：\( y = \text{down}\big(\text{SiLU}(\text{gate}(x)) \odot \text{up}(x)\big) \)。`gate_proj` 与 `up_proj` 都是 \( \text{intermediate} \times \text{hidden} \)，且**吃同一段输入** \( x \)——正好满足融合条件。于是两者按行堆叠成 \( 2 \times \text{intermediate} \times \text{hidden} \) 的 `gate_up_proj`；`down_proj`（\( \text{hidden} \times \text{intermediate} \)）输入是逐元素乘积，保持独立。

这里"行偏移"同样只有两个值：gate 在 \( [0, \text{inter}) \)、up 在 \( [\text{inter}, 2\text{inter}) \)（TP 下用本地 `inter`）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

1. 装载期：`gate_proj.weight` + `up_proj.weight` → `fused_rows` → \( (2 \times \text{inter}_{\text{local}}) \times \text{hidden} \) 单矩阵。
2. 运行期：
   - gate_out = GEMM(gate_up_proj 行 \( [0, \text{inter}) \), normed)
   - up_out = GEMM(gate_up_proj 行 \( [\text{inter}, 2\text{inter}) \), normed)
   - act = SiLU(gate_out) ⊙ up_out
   - mlp_out = GEMM(down_proj, act)

Qwen3-4B（inter=9728, hidden=2560，TP=1）：`gate_up_proj` 是 \( 19456 \times 2560 \)，gate 段 [0, 9728)，up 段 [9728, 19456)。

### 4.3 Qwen3Model：权重 + 配置，不含请求状态

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`Qwen3Model` 是"这台推理发动机的静止部分"：词嵌入、每层权重、最终 norm、RoPE 表、配置、TP 通信子，以及（若启用）打包的 LoRA 注册表。它的文档注释只有一句话——"weights and config only. Request state is owned by the executor."这句话是整个 crate 所有权设计的分水岭：

- **模型侧（本讲）**：装载后基本不可变（唯一例外是 LoRA 热装卸）。权重指针稳定，是 CUDA Graph 捕获/重放的前提（图会把指针"烤"进录制流，u3-l5）。
- **执行器侧（u3 单元）**：每个请求的 KV 页、位置、采样参数、草稿状态都由 executor/调度器持有，随请求生灭。

这样切分的直接收益：模型可以在 TP 下"每 rank 一个、绝不跨线程共享"地被 move 进各自的 worker 线程；服务循环对模型只读，天然无数据竞争。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

一个 `Qwen3Model` 的字段可以分四组来记：

1. **设备与配置**：`ctx`（CUDA 设备上下文）、`config`（u2-l1 的 `Config`）、`tensor_parallel`、`decode_projection_path`（u3-l8 的融合路径选择结果，装载期定死）。
2. **权重本体**：`embed_tokens`（\( \text{vocab} \times \text{hidden} \)）、`lm_head: Option<DeviceMatrix>`（tied 时为 `None`）、`layers: Vec<TransformerBlock>`（36 层）、`norm`（最终 RMSNorm）。
3. **常量表**：`cos_cache` / `sin_cache`（RoPE 预计算表）、`logits_tail_suppress`（对齐填充的词表尾部抑制 ids）。
4. **服务机制开关与 LoRA**：`enable_cuda_graph`、`tp_comm`（NCCL 通信子）、`lora_adapters` / `packed_lora` / `max_loras` / `max_lora_rank`（u7 详讲）。

其中 `TransformerBlock`（[src/weights.rs:L122-L128](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L122-L128)）= 两个 RMSNorm 向量 + 一个 `Attention` + 一个 `MLP`，正是一个解码层的全部静止状态。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**结构体与文档注释**——[src/weights.rs:L331-L351](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L331-L351)：`Qwen3Model` 全字段如上分组；注意 `lm_head` 是 `Option`。

**Send/Sync 的 SAFETY 说明**——[src/weights.rs:L353-L357](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L353-L357)：手动 `unsafe impl Send/Sync`，理由写在注释里——"每个模型实例钉在一个 CUDA 设备上，同一时刻只由一个 worker 线程驱动；TP 路径每 rank 一个模型，从不在多线程间共享同一个 rank 本地模型"。这是 4.3.1 所有权设计的 unsafe 背书。

### 4.4 Qwen3MemoryOptions：显存预算三参数

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

权重装载完只是显存账本的第一行。KV 池能开多大，由 `Qwen3MemoryOptions` 的三个参数决定。它模仿 vLLM 的 `gpu_memory_utilization` 语义：**KV 池拿走"预算内扣除权重、画像出的非 KV 运行时峰值、安全余量"之后的剩余部分**。三个参数各管一件事：

| 参数 | 默认值 | 管什么 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `gpu_memory_utilization` | 0.90 | 总预算 = \( \text{设备总显存} \times \) 该比例；要求 \( (0, 1] \) |
| `kv_cache_memory_margin_bytes` | 150 MiB | 在画像峰值之外再扣的固定安全垫，覆盖分配器碎片与未画像到的小额漂移 |
| `page_size` | 16 | KV 页粒度（每页容纳的 token 数）；合法值只有 {16, 64}，由 FlashInfer 分页注意力内核决定（见源码引用的 #545） |

定性公式（完整画像流程在 u2-l4）：

\[
\text{kv\_budget} = \underbrace{\text{total} \times u}_{\text{requested}} - \Big( \underbrace{\text{initial\_used}}_{\text{权重等}} + \underbrace{\text{non\_kv\_peak}}_{\text{画像峰值增量}} + \underbrace{m}_{\text{margin}} \Big)
\]

每 KV 块的字节数则有唯一公式（`kv_bytes_per_block`，见下）：

\[
\text{bytes\_per\_block} = \text{num\_layers} \times 2 \times \text{num\_kv\_heads} \times \text{head\_dim} \times \text{block\_size} \times 2\,\text{B}
\]

（因子 2 = K 与 V 各一份；最后一个 2 = bf16。）`page_size` 越大，块越"粗"，前缀匹配的粒度越粗（u5-l1），但每块字节数成比例增大；它不改变总预算，只改变切分粒度与最小可分配单位。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

1. `Qwen3MemoryOptions::new(u, margin, page)` 构造（const fn），`Default` 给 `(0.90, 150 MiB, 16)`。
2. 使用前必须 `validate()`：\( u \in (0, 1] \)，`page_size ∈ {16, 64}`，否则立即报错。
3. 启动画像（`profiled_kv_budget`，u2-l4 详讲）先 `validate()`，再以 `page_size` 构造 KV 几何、按上式算每块字节，最后从预算里数出块数（不足 64 块的最低限直接拒绝启动）。
4. `page_size` 同时决定调度器的 token 粒度：一个请求占用的 KV 页数 = \( \lceil \text{len} / \text{page\_size} \rceil \)。

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**默认常量**——[src/weights.rs:L31-L36](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L31-L36)：`DEFAULT_GPU_MEMORY_UTILIZATION = 0.90`、`DEFAULT_KV_CACHE_MEMORY_MARGIN_BYTES = 150 MiB`、`DEFAULT_KV_PAGE_SIZE = 16`，以及 `VALID_KV_PAGE_SIZES = &[16, 64]`——注释点明这来自 FlashInfer 分页注意力内核的接受集（issue #545）。

**结构体与字段注释**——[src/weights.rs:L38-L50](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L38-L50)：`gpu_memory_utilization` 的注释就是那句"KV 拿预算内剩余"的语义；`kv_cache_memory_margin_bytes` 说明是"画像结果之外的额外扣留，覆盖分配器碎片与小幅未画像漂移"；`page_size` 注释指向 `VALID_KV_PAGE_SIZES` 与 CLI 旗标 `--kv-page-size`。

**校验**——[src/weights.rs:L65-L78](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L65-L78)：两条 `anyhow::ensure!`，错误信息分别带上非法的 utilization 数值与完整合法页尺寸列表——"失败越早越便宜"（u2-l1 的同一信条在内存选项上的落点）。

**Default**——[src/weights.rs:L81-L89](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L81-L89)：三个默认常量的组装点。

**每块字节数的唯一公式Owner**——[src/weights.rs:L823-L861](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L823-L861)：`kv_page_bytes` 的文档写着"The Single owner of this formula — callers that bill KV pages must not re-derive it"（凡给 KV 页记账的调用方不得自行推导）；`kv_bytes_per_block` 在构造 layout **之前**先用 `crate::sizing::product` 对全乘积做 checked 计算，注释解释：`KvLayout::new` 内部用普通乘法推导步长，而这里的全乘积支配一切部分乘积，先清零它等于全部清零。`debug_assert_eq!` 再对照 layout 的 `page_stride` 自证一致。

**最低块数**——[src/weights.rs:L863-L864](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L863-L864)：`MIN_KV_BLOCKS = 64`，"调度器能推进的最小池"；预算数不出 64 块时启动失败（[src/weights.rs:L893-L906](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L893-L906)，且按"含 DFlash 摊派的 effective 字节"判，见该处注释）。

**已有单测**——[src/weights.rs:L1143-L1154](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L1143-L1154)：`memory_options_rejects_invalid_page_sizes` 遍历 0/1/15/17/32/63/65/128 断言全部被拒且错误信息提到 `page_size`——这就是 4.4.4 实践要跑的测试。

#### 4.4.4 代码实践

**实践目标**：跑通一条不依赖 GPU 的单测，并亲手代入每块字节数公式。

1. 操作步骤：
   - 运行 `cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --lib memory_options`，应看到 `memory_options_rejects_invalid_page_sizes` 通过。
   - 手工代入 Qwen3-4B、TP=1、page_size=16：\( 36 \times 2 \times 8 \times 128 \times 16 \times 2\,\text{B} = 2{,}359{,}296\,\text{B} = 2.25\,\text{MiB/块} \)。
   - 再算 page_size=64 时的每块字节（应为 9 MiB），并算 24 GB 卡、utilization=0.90、暂不计权重时最多能容纳多少个 16-token 块（量级估算即可）。
2. 需要观察的现象：lib 单测在无 GPU 环境也能编译并通过（它只做整数与字符串断言）；`--lib` 过滤器只命中一个测试。
3. 预期结果：每块 2.25 MiB（page 16）/ 9 MiB（page 64）；24 GB × 0.9 ≈ 21.6 GB 的量级里若全给 KV（现实中要先扣权重，此处仅为公式练习）约可容纳 ~9100 个 16-token 块。单测运行结果待本地验证（取决于本地工具链）。

#### 4.4.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：为什么 `page_size` 只允许 16 或 64？

答案：KV 池的分页注意力内核来自 FlashInfer，其内核只接受这两个页尺寸（源码注释指向 #545）。选 64 时每块覆盖更多 token、页表更短，但小请求的尾部浪费更大；选 16 更细但页表项更多。这是内核能力约束，不是任意调参。

**练习 2**：把 `gpu_memory_utilization` 设成 1.0 合法吗？设成 0.0 呢？

答案：1.0 合法（区间是半开的 \( (0, 1] \)），但画像若发现非 KV 占用已经吃满预算会拒绝启动；0.0 非法，`validate()` 的第一条 ensure 直接拒绝——预算为零意味着连 64 块的最小池都不可能（[src/weights.rs:L66-L70](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L66-L70)）。

**练习 3**：`kv_cache_memory_margin_bytes` 与 `gpu_memory_utilization` 都是"留余量"，区别是什么？

答案：utilization 在**总量**层面封顶（比例），margin 在**分配**层面扣减（固定字节，盖碎片与未画像漂移）。前者决定池子最大多大，后者决定画像峰值之外还要再让出多少才敢把剩余全部划给 KV——两者叠加后才是 `kv_budget_bytes`。

## 5. 综合实践

**任务：手工推导 Qwen3-4B 的 QKV + MLP 权重字节数，并用 `sizing.rs` 的 checked 乘加写成单测。**

这是本讲的收官实践，把 4.1/4.2 的形状、4.3 的所有权、4.4 的预算意识串成一条线：**知道权重占多少字节，才能看懂 u2-l4 里"预算扣掉权重之后剩多少给 KV"的账本。**

### 5.1 手工推导（Qwen3-4B，TP=1，bf16）

几何：`hidden=2560, layers=36, heads=32, kv_heads=8, head_dim=128, intermediate=9728`，故 \( q_{\text{dim}} = 32 \times 128 = 4096 \)，\( kv_{\text{dim}} = 8 \times 128 = 1024 \)。

| 矩阵 | 形状 | 元素数 | bf16 字节 | 每层 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `qkv_proj` | \( 6144 \times 2560 \) | 15,728,640 | 31,457,280 B | **30 MiB** |
| `gate_up_proj` | \( 19456 \times 2560 \) | 49,807,360 | 99,614,720 B | **95 MiB** |
| `down_proj` | \( 2560 \times 9728 \) | 24,903,680 | 49,807,360 B | **47.5 MiB** |

- 每层 QKV+MLP 合计：\( 30 + 95 + 47.5 = 172.5 \) MiB。
- 36 层合计：\( 172.5 \times 36 = 6210 \) MiB ≈ 6.06 GiB（精确值 6,511,656,960 字节）。
- （延伸）`o_proj` \( 2560 \times 4096 \) 每层 20 MiB，36 层 720 MiB；`embed_tokens`（tied，兼作输出投影）\( 151936 \times 2560 \times 2 \approx 741.6 \) MiB。全模型约 4.02B 参数 ≈ 7.5 GiB——与"Qwen3-4B"的名字对上。

### 5.2 写成单测

先看工具：[src/sizing.rs:L1-L22](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs#L1-L22) 只有两个函数——`product`（`checked_mul` 折叠，溢出报 "sizing overflow in product"）与 `sum`（`checked_add`）。模块注释说明了它存在的意义：**预算在配置维度通过张量校验之前就要计算，坏配置必须在这里响亮失败，而不是回绕成少预留**。这正是 u2-l4 显存画像所有乘法的地基。

由于 `product`/`sum` 是 `pub(crate)`（同理 `Attention`/`MLP`/`Qwen3Model` 也只在 crate 内可见，u1-l1 已建立"runtime 再导出才是公共边界"的认知），这个练习测试**必须写进 crate 内部**——在**你自己的工作副本**里把它加到 [src/weights.rs:L959](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L959) 之后的 `#[cfg(test)] mod tests` 中（学习练习，勿提交）：

```rust
// 示例代码：加入 src/weights.rs 的 tests 模块（学习用，不改动生产逻辑）
use crate::sizing::{product, sum};

const HIDDEN: usize = 2560;
const LAYERS: usize = 36;
const Q_DIM: usize = 32 * 128;      // 4096
const KV_DIM: usize = 8 * 128;      // 1024
const INTER: usize = 9728;
const BF16: usize = std::mem::size_of::<half::bf16>();

#[test]
fn qwen3_4b_qkv_and_mlp_weight_bytes() {
    let qkv = product(&[Q_DIM + 2 * KV_DIM, HIDDEN, BF16])?;
    let gate_up = product(&[2 * INTER, HIDDEN, BF16])?;
    let down = product(&[HIDDEN, INTER, BF16])?;
    let per_layer = sum(&[qkv, gate_up, down])?;
    let all_layers = product(&[per_layer, LAYERS])?;

    assert_eq!(qkv, 31_457_280);          // 30 MiB
    assert_eq!(gate_up, 99_614_720);      // 95 MiB
    assert_eq!(down, 49_807_360);         // 47.5 MiB
    assert_eq!(all_layers, 6_511_656_960); // ≈6.06 GiB
}
```

> 注：`product`/`sum` 返回 `Result<usize>`，测试里用 `?` 需要 conclude 返回 `Result`，或改用 `.expect("sane dims")`——推荐后者，与本文件既有测试的 `expect` 风格一致。

### 5.3 对照与验证

1. 与 `weights.rs` 已有测试对照组织方式：[src/weights.rs:L969-L1003](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L969-L1003) 的 KV 预算测试同样用字面常量构造几何（36 层/8 头/128 维/16 块）、用 `expect_err` + `contains("overflow")` 断言失败形态——你的字节数测试与它们同处一个模块、共享同一风格。
2. 与真实 checkpoint 对照：拿本地 `models/Qwen3-4B/config.json` 的五个维度代入，若与 5.1 的表完全一致即通过。可再用 `ls -l` 对比分片 safetensors 的总大小（含 embed 与 o_proj，约 7.5 GiB + 元数据）。
3. 运行：`cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --lib weights::tests::qwen3_4b`。该测试只做整数运算，无需 GPU；通过与否取决于你手工推导的数字——本文的推导已逐步列出，运行结果待本地验证。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `Attention` 把 Q/K/V 按行堆成单矩阵 \( (q_{\text{dim}} + 2kv_{\text{dim}}) \times \text{hidden} \)，前向用行偏移 \( 0 / q_{\text{dim}} / q_{\text{dim}}+kv_{\text{dim}} \) 读取（[src/batch_decode.rs:L346-L372](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/batch_decode.rs#L346-L372)），融合只是拼字节，零额外显存。
- `MLP` 同理把 gate+up 合成 \( 2\text{inter} \times \text{hidden} \)，偏移 0 与 inter；`o_proj`/`down_proj` 因输入不同源而保持独立。
- `Qwen3Model` = 权重 + 配置 + 常量表（RoPE/norm）+ 机制开关，**不含任何请求状态**；请求状态归 executor，这使稳态服务对模型只读，是 CUDA Graph 指针稳定与 TP 每 rank 一份的前提。
- `Qwen3MemoryOptions` 三参数分工：utilization 定总预算、margin 定画像外安全垫、page_size 定 KV 块粒度（只允许 16/64，FlashInfer 内核约束）。
- 每块 KV 字节数有唯一公式Owner `kv_bytes_per_block`，且一切尺寸乘法必须走 [src/sizing.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/sizing.rs) 的 checked 乘加——坏配置要响亮失败，不许回绕成少预留。
- Qwen3-4B 的 QKV+MLP 权重共约 6210 MiB（每层 172.5 MiB：30 + 95 + 47.5），全模型约 7.5 GiB——这是 u2-l4 显存账本里"权重"那一行的数值。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

本讲看到的是"静止的模型"。下一讲 **u2-l3（checkpoint 装载）** 讲这堆矩阵是怎么从 safetensors 分片走进显存的：`load_shard_info` 的分片探测、`StagedWeightLoader` 的"先记录整个计划再上传"两阶段结构、以及 TP>1 时 `shard_range`/`col_shard` 的行切与列切边界。之后 **u2-l4（显存画像与 KV 预算）** 会把本讲 4.4 的定性公式展开成 `profiled_kv_budget` 的完整账本：画像临时块、激活峰值测量、`servable_len` 折算。建议顺带重读 [src/weights.rs:L692-L818](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/weights.rs#L692-L818)，此时你已能认出其中每一个字段。

You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).

- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
  // Dimension 'bugs' findings verify while dimension 'perf' is still reviewing. No wasted wall-clock.
